description: The agent's publish-flow logs read by the commit-cadence analysis of 2026-10-06: one stage mark per line, as '<epoch seconds> <Athens HH:MM:SS> <stage> start|end', with STOP and PUBLISHED lines. tae/ are #369's rounds, mut/ #374's, scratchpad/timing-* the earlier runs. Concatenated, each file headed by '=== <name>'. Also the agent's local whole-table mutant results, scratchpad/369-r*-mutants.txt and 374-r*-mutants.txt, whose mtimes date the local runs. Each file's mtime, in epoch seconds, is retained: the analysis reads a stopped run's end, and a local run's end, from it.
